description: Records a payment against a specific bill, resolving accessionId and patientRegistrationId server-side from the bill.

body.paymentMode: enum, required - CASH | CARD | UPI | NET_BANKING | CHEQUE | WALLET | CORPORATE_CREDIT

validation: billingId must reference an existing bill
the bill's accession and patient registration are resolved server-side to satisfy payment.accession_id and payment.patient_registration_id (both NOT NULL)
amountPaid must be >= 0 (CHECK) - see database_gap note
paymentMode must reference a code in payment_mode_master
notes: accession_id is NOT NULL on the payment table, so this endpoint requires the target bill to already have an associated accession (accession_master.billing_id = billingId) - if a bill has no accession yet, this endpoint cannot create a payment. This precondition is not explicitly documented in docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx and may need business confirmation for bills paid before accessioning.
